definitions:
QUESTION. Each ITEM is an address string from a City of Berkeley record (a permit, a Planning record, the
Rent Board registry, a business license) that does not match any address in the City's own address list. Below it
are CANDIDATES from that list: addresses on the same street with nearby house numbers, streets with similar names,
and the City's address for the record's parcel when the record names one.
Decide whether the item refers to one of the candidates. If none fits but the record's own text (the "e.g." quote)
names a full street address, give it as "stated" (copied exactly from that text); it is kept only if it is in the
City's list. Pick a candidate ONLY if the item plainly means that
address: the same address written differently ('VINCENTE' for 'VICENTE'), or a unit / half / rear of that address
('1707 1/4 Oxford' -> 1707 Oxford), or the City's address for the same parcel. Do NOT pick the nearest number just
because it is near: a house number that is simply absent from the list is "not_in_city_list". If the text is not
an address at all, answer "not_an_address".
reason must be one of: same_address_different_form, spelling_or_typo, unit_or_half_of_a_listed_address, renumbered_or_replatted, not_in_city_list, not_an_address.
rule: a pick is kept only if it is one of the City-list candidates offered

CalWEA is a non-profit trade association representing the California wind energy industry. CalWEA has one employee, Nancy Rader, now working out of a home office. (Otherwise, CalWEA relies on consultants.) Prior office address was 2560 Ninth Street, Suite 213A, Berkeley CA 94710.

My wife and I are psychotherapists.  We will be seeing people in a psychotherapy office at 2811A College Avenue, Berkeley CA 94705.  But we have a business registered at our home, though we will not be seeing people there.

The new business is an Online Yoga Studio. All I will be doing is adding to my website yogafortimesofchange.com the ability for people to pay for and register for online yoga classes and workshops (taught over Zoom). I work from my home (1324 Peralta Avenue, Berkeley CA 94702). There will be no physical products, no additional people coming to the house (all lessons will be via video, some conducted in different parts of the US and not by me), no additional parking needed, no deliveries of anything, and nothing at all I can think of that will affect people in the neighborhood. I already work at home as a freelance writer and have everything I need installed already (basically internet and computer).
